title: Midjourney is buying horoscope app Co-Star, which users will surely be thrilled about - Engadget
summary: Co-Star CEO Banu Guler is also becoming the company's Chief Design Officer. The company has announced it's purchasing Co-Star, a popular astrology app, and bringing on its CEO Banu Guler as its new Chief Design Officer.
